title: Scrubbed Log Casefile
user: Engineers escalating a bug who need a useful log bundle without leaking passwords, identifiers, or configuration.
smallest_useful_product: An offline CLI that applies named redaction policies, preserves stable placeholders across files, records which rule fired without values, and produces a shareable encrypted zip plus manifest.
constraints: Offline by default; atomic temp-file cleanup; user-owned rules; never claim complete PII detection or encrypt with a service-held key.
